zh.title: 切到后台时不再错过更新提示
zh.description: 新版加载时如果页面恰好不在前台，更新摘要会在回到页面后再出现，而不是被跳过。

zh.title: HTTP 地址下多标签页的更新提示不再卡住
zh.description: 通过局域网 HTTP 地址使用时，关闭或刷新一个标签页不会再让其他标签页的更新提示延迟约 30 秒。

zh.title: 更新提示的诊断日志更准确
zh.description: 无法展示更新摘要时，日志会写明具体原因，同类问题不再重复刷屏。

en.title: Update notices are no longer missed in background tabs
en.description: If the page is not in the foreground when a new release loads, the summary now appears once you return instead of being skipped.

en.title: Update notices no longer stall across tabs on HTTP addresses
en.description: On a plain HTTP LAN address, closing or reloading one tab no longer delays the update notice in other tabs by about 30 seconds.

en.title: Clearer update notice diagnostics
en.description: When the summary cannot be shown, the log now states the reason, and repeated causes are logged only once.
